value.rationale: Reverse monotone likelihood-ratio ordering is a substantial natural strengthening of a lucky/displacement inverse-association intuition in linear-probing probabilistic parking. The first admissible counterexample at four cars with just a factor-two weight contrast sharply identifies the limit of a universal dependence principle; this is not an arbitrary numeric constant or mere reparametrization.
